<subject>Re: AgriIndia From GreenFields</subject>
<body>
Reyansh Salvi

As I understand it, Hebert lacks the contractual authority (and the petition is unclear) to halt deliveries under the supply agreement (he likely also lacks the stakeholder backing for this).

However, the Farm Partnerships unit could support this in its submission as a way to advance the smallholder farmer issue.

Hardik





	Reyansh Krish
	Sent by: Reyansh Krish
	3/19/2024 10:04 AM
		 
		 To: Dakshesh Basak, Libni Kibe, Charita 
Balay, Amruta Wali, Manya 
Bal, Hardik Pal, Christopher 
Baral, Matthew Nazareth, Vrinda Mangat
		 cc: 
		 Subject: AgriIndia From GreenFields

FYI. Any feedback Dakshesh & team? Is contract termination an "increase supply" strategy? My worry is that smallholders get freed and then Pune's "regulatory clampdown" mindset activates, implementing Zansi Pillay legislation, etc. to ensure the grain from these farms stays within Pune.

Best,
Reyansh
</body>
